chapters.title: Solomon asks for wisdom
chapters.summary: At Gibeon, God offers Solomon whatever he asks. Solomon asks for wisdom and knowledge to lead the people, and God gives him wealth and honor as well.

chapters.title: Preparing to build
chapters.summary: Solomon arranges with Hiram of Tyre for materials and a skilled craftsman, knowing that heaven itself cannot contain God.

chapters.title: Building the temple
chapters.summary: Solomon builds the temple on Mount Moriah, where God appeared to David, with gold, cherubim, a veil and two great pillars.

chapters.title: The temple furnishings
chapters.summary: The bronze altar, the great sea, basins, lampstands, tables and other furnishings are made.

chapters.title: The glory fills the temple
chapters.summary: The ark is brought into the temple. As the singers and trumpeters praise God, for He is good, the cloud of His glory fills the house.

chapters.title: Solomon's prayer
chapters.summary: Solomon dedicates the temple and prays that God will hear His people whenever they pray toward this place, forgive them, and also hear the foreigner.

chapters.title: If my people humble themselves
chapters.summary: Fire falls on the sacrifices. God appears to Solomon and promises: if my people pray, seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, I will hear and heal their land.

chapters.title: Solomon's achievements
chapters.summary: Solomon builds cities, organizes temple worship as David directed, and sends ships to trade for gold.

chapters.title: The queen of Sheba
chapters.summary: The queen of Sheba visits and is overwhelmed by Solomon's wisdom and prosperity. Solomon reigns forty years and dies.

chapters.title: The kingdom divides
chapters.summary: Rehoboam rejects the elders' advice and answers the people harshly. The northern tribes reject him and follow Jeroboam.

chapters.title: Rehoboam strengthens Judah
chapters.summary: God forbids war against Israel. Rehoboam fortifies Judah, and faithful priests and Levites move from the north to Jerusalem.

chapters.title: Egypt invades
chapters.summary: Rehoboam forsakes God's law and Egypt's king Shishak invades. When the leaders humble themselves, God limits the judgment.

chapters.title: Abijah's battle
chapters.summary: Abijah of Judah calls on Israel not to fight against God. Though outnumbered and surrounded, Judah cries out and God gives them victory.

chapters.title: Asa relies on God
chapters.summary: Asa removes idols and gives Judah rest. When a huge Cushite army attacks, he prays, "Help us, for we rest on thee," and God routs them.

chapters.title: Asa's reforms
chapters.summary: The prophet Azariah urges Asa to seek God. Asa removes idols, renews the covenant, and removes his own grandmother as queen mother.

chapters.title: Asa's last years
chapters.summary: Asa relies on Aram instead of God, and the seer Hanani rebukes him: God's eyes run to and fro to strengthen those whose heart is perfect toward Him.

chapters.title: Jehoshaphat teaches the law
chapters.summary: Jehoshaphat walks in David's early ways, removes idols, and sends officials and Levites to teach the law throughout Judah.

chapters.title: Micaiah's warning
chapters.summary: Jehoshaphat allies with Ahab. The prophet Micaiah alone foretells defeat, and Ahab dies in battle as he said.

chapters.title: Jehoshaphat appoints judges
chapters.summary: Rebuked for helping wicked Ahab, Jehoshaphat appoints judges and tells them to judge in the fear of the Lord, without partiality or bribes.

chapters.title: The battle is God's
chapters.summary: A vast army comes against Judah. Jehoshaphat prays, "Our eyes are upon thee," God says the battle is His, and as the singers praise, the enemies destroy one another.

chapters.title: Jehoram's evil reign
chapters.summary: Jehoram kills his brothers and follows Ahab's ways. Edom revolts, Elijah sends a letter of judgment, and Jehoram dies unmourned.

chapters.title: Athaliah seizes power
chapters.summary: Ahaziah reigns briefly under his mother Athaliah's counsel. After his death she kills the royal family, but baby Joash is hidden.

chapters.title: Joash crowned
chapters.summary: The priest Jehoiada organizes the Levites and crowns young Joash in the temple. Athaliah is executed, and the people renew the covenant.

chapters.title: Joash repairs and turns away
chapters.summary: Joash repairs the temple while Jehoiada lives, but afterward turns to idols and has Jehoiada's son Zechariah stoned for warning him.

chapters.title: Amaziah
chapters.summary: Amaziah defeats Edom but brings back Edom's gods, then foolishly challenges Israel and is defeated.

chapters.title: Uzziah's pride
chapters.summary: Uzziah seeks God and prospers greatly, but in pride he burns incense in the temple, which only priests may do, and is struck with leprosy.

chapters.title: Jotham
chapters.summary: Jotham builds and prospers because he ordered his ways before the Lord his God.

chapters.title: Ahaz
chapters.summary: Ahaz worships idols, sacrifices his sons and closes the temple doors. Judah suffers defeats, and Israel releases captives at a prophet's word.

chapters.title: Hezekiah reopens the temple
chapters.summary: Hezekiah opens and repairs the temple, the Levites cleanse it, and worship with offerings and songs is restored.

chapters.title: The great Passover
chapters.summary: Hezekiah invites all Israel, even the north, to keep Passover in Jerusalem. He prays for those not yet purified, and there is great joy.

chapters.title: Giving for the temple
chapters.summary: The people tear down idols and bring so many tithes and offerings that heaps form. Hezekiah did everything with all his heart.

chapters.title: Sennacherib defeated
chapters.summary: Assyria invades and mocks God. Hezekiah encourages the people, "With us is the Lord our God," and an angel destroys the Assyrian army.

chapters.title: Manasseh repents
chapters.summary: Manasseh leads Judah into great evil and is taken captive to Babylon. There he humbles himself and prays, and God restores him.

chapters.title: Josiah finds the law
chapters.summary: Young Josiah seeks God and purges idolatry. The book of the law is found, Josiah humbles himself, and he leads the people to renew the covenant.

chapters.title: Josiah's Passover
chapters.summary: Josiah keeps a Passover unlike any since Samuel. Later he goes against Pharaoh Neco's warning and is killed at Megiddo.

chapters.title: Exile and return
chapters.summary: Judah's last kings ignore God's messengers. Jerusalem and the temple are destroyed and the people exiled, until Cyrus of Persia decrees they may return and rebuild.
